steps.title: Define project requirements for Simple Clicker app
steps.description: Outline user expectations including real-time visual increment/decrement updates, reset triggers, persistence configurations, and orientation security.

steps.title: Initialize directories and configure Android build environment
steps.description: Construct clean directory structures for com.simpleclicker.app following Gradle standards and asset distributions.

steps.title: Create app-meta.json metadata file
steps.description: Generate static meta definitions for mapping the Simple Clicker app name and target namespace securely within compiling tasks.

steps.title: Create app level build.gradle configurations
steps.description: Setup compilation SDK target of 34, minimum SDK of 21, and declare source compatibility requirements pointing to standard Java 1.8 instructions.

steps.title: Write AndroidManifest.xml package architecture
steps.description: Draft valid configuration containing standard launch category intents, strict layout orientations, launch theme, and custom application attributes.

steps.title: Create activity_main.xml layout structure
steps.description: Design an elegant dashboard UI leveraging clean vertical groups, clear numeric text layouts, state modifiers, and dynamic visual counters.

steps.title: Create MainActivity.java and import system frameworks
steps.description: Setup package pointers and standard system widgets inside standard Android SDK class scopes without third-party reliance.

steps.title: Implement click listeners using Java 8 compatibility standards
steps.description: Attach button click callbacks targeting increment, decrement, and clear actions using stable, robust traditional anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Develop Local SharedPreferences persistence engine
steps.description: Save high-score counters and session statistics to local persistent file structures allowing app reloads to retain player benchmarks.

steps.title: Implement secure system UI state handling features
steps.description: Hook into onSaveInstanceState and restore lifecycle configurations ensuring current session counter holds steady across layout changes.

steps.title: Review overall app layout for response consistency
steps.description: Verify container paddings, visual button spacing, target margins, and accessibility text sizing constraints across various screen heights.

steps.title: Validate manifest namespace compatibility parameters
steps.description: Validate and lock in appropriate standard namespace properties inside XML sheets to ensure seamless compilation with AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Building Simple Clicker
steps.description: Execute final Gradle build pipelines to compile project targets, perform static inspections, and build the APK payload.
